observations: Photo 0 shows a large green cylindrical hopper with a conical bottom, mounted on a green metal frame, connected via a green chute to a smaller green machine with a blue motor.
Photo 1 shows the same green hopper and machine setup, with three men around it; one is working on the ground, another standing, and a third sitting on a metal drum.
The setup appears to be outdoors on bare ground, under trees, with tools and materials scattered around.
A watermark 'VOGUE STEEL FABRICATIONS' is visible on both photos.
The machine components are painted bright green, suggesting recent fabrication or maintenance.
No visible brand or model markings on the machinery.
The seller claims it is a 'Complete 2 Tonnes Poultry/ Chicken feed mill machine' including a mixer, hammer mill crusher, and other components.

claims.claim: Complete 2 Tonnes Poultry/ Chicken feed mill machine, these include mixer, hammer mill crusher, and...
claims.evidence: Photos show a hopper and a motorized machine, but no clear view of a mixer or hammer mill crusher. The components are not labeled or shown in operation. The claim of '2 Tonnes' capacity is not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: The machine may not be complete as claimed (missing mixer, hammer mill crusher, or other components).
risks.proof: A clear photo showing all claimed components (mixer, hammer mill crusher, etc.) labeled or connected to the system.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or missing parts

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may require significant assembly or repairs.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the machine in operation, or a close-up of all connections, motors, and controls.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or requiring repair

risks.risk: The '2 Tonnes' capacity claim may be inaccurate or exaggerated.
risks.proof: A technical specification sheet or a photo showing the machine's capacity markings or a demonstration of throughput.

proof_requests: Clear photos of all components (mixer, hammer mill crusher, etc.) showing how they connect to the system.
A video or photo of the machine in operation.
Photos of any control panels, motors, or capacity markings.
Proof of the machine's capacity (e.g., technical specs or demonstration).
response.reason: The photos show a green hopper and motorized machine, but do not confirm the presence of all claimed components (mixer, hammer mill crusher) or their functionality. The '2 Tonnes' capacity is unverifiable. Without proof of completeness and operation, the item cannot be priced accurately.
